spans.s:
निंस् निंस् (thought by some to be a con-
traction of निनंस्, old Desid. of rt. नम्),
cl. 2. A. निंस्ते (2nd sing. निंस्से, 2nd sing. Impv.
निंस्स्व), निनिंसे, निंसितुम्, &c., Ved. to touch,
kiss, salute. (After प्र the initial न् is optionally
cerebralized, cf. प्र-णिंसितव्य, प्र-निंसितव्य,
परि-णिंसक; cf. also rt. निक्ष्.)

निनङ्क्षु निनङ्क्षु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. Desid. of
rt. 2. नश्), wishing or expecting to perish or die.

निनद् नि-नद्, cl. 1. P. -नदति, &c., to
sound, make a sound, cry out; to resound: Caus.
P. -नादयति, -यितुम्, to cause to sound or resound,
fill with noise, cries, &c.

नि-नद or नि-नाद, अस्, m. sound, noise, cry,
buzzing, humming, crying.

नि-नादित, अस्, आ, अम्, made to sound, filled with
noise or cries; (अम्), n. a sound.

नि-नादिन्, ई, इनी, इ, sounding, resounding, ringing,
crying; causing to sound, playing (as a musical
instrument).
निनयन नि-नयन. See नि-नी below.

नि-नयन, अम्, n. carrying out, performing,
accomplishing; performance; pouring down.

निनर्तशत्रु निनर्त-शत्रु, उस्, m., N. of a
son of An-ādhṛṣṭi.

निनर्द् नि-नर्द्, cl. 1. P. -नर्दति, -नर्दि-
तुम्, to sound; prolong a note in chanting; [cf.
अव-नर्द्.]

नि-नर्द, अस्, m. prolonging a note in chanting,
trilling.

नि-नर्दत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, sounding; prolonging
a cadence.

निनह् नि-नह्, cl. 4. P. A. -नह्यति, -ते,
-नद्धुम्, Ved. to fasten, tie; [cf. नीनाह.]
नि-नद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, fastened, tied fast.

नि-नाह्य, अस्, m., Ved. a water-jar; (according to
the commentaries) a water-jar put into the ground.

निनित्सु निनित्सु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. Desid. of rt.
निद्), Ved. wishing to censure or blame.

निनी नि-नी, cl. 1. P. A. -नयति, -ते, -ने-
तुम्, to lead to, carry or bring towards, bring near,
bring, fetch; to incline, bend; to pour on or into
(Ved.); to carry out, perform, accomplish, cause; to
spend (time).

निनीषा निनीषा, f. (fr. Desid. of rt. 1. नी),
wishing to bring, desire or intention of carrying or
taking or leading away.

निनीषु, उस्, उस्, उ, desirous to take or lead, wishing
to bring; wishing to spend (as time).

निनृत्त नि-नृत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, repeated (as a
portion of a verse or syllable; lit. danced again).
—निनृत्त-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having repetition (as
above).
नि-नृत्ति, इस्, f. repetition.

निन्द् निन्द् (sometimes written निद्, q. v.),
cl. 1. P. निन्दति (rarely A. -ते), निनिन्द,
निन्दिष्यति, अनिन्दीत्, निन्दितुम्, to blame, censure,
reprimand, contemn, despise, ridicule.

निन्द in निन्द-तल, अस्, ई, अम्, = निन्दित-
हस्त, having a maimed or defective hand; (some-
times read निम्न-तल.)

निन्दा, f. blame, censure, reproach, reproof, abuse,
defamation, scorn, reviling; injury, injuring, wicked-
ness; [cf. निदा.]
—निन्दा-स्तुति, इस्, f. praise which
involves reproof, ironical praise, irony.

निन्दक, अस्, आ, अम्, blaming, defaming, re-
proachful, abusive, scurrilous, censorious; one who
ridicules or blames, a scorner.

निन्दत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, blaming, censuring, abusing,
ridiculing.
निन्दन, अम्, n. reproach, censure, blame.

निन्दनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, blamable, liable to reproof
or censure or blame, reprehensible; [cf. अ-न्˚.]

निन्दित, अस्, आ, अम्, blamed, abused, reviled,
reproved, despised, rejected; low, despicable, worthy
of being reviled; prohibited, forbidden.

निन्दितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. one who ridicules or
blames or despises.
निन्दिन्, ई, इनी, इ, blaming, censuring, reproaching.
निन्दु, उस्, f. a woman bearing a dead child.

निन्द्य, अस्, आ, अम्, blamable, to be censured or
reproached, despicable, reprehensible, bad, vile; for-
bidden, prohibited; [cf. अ-न्.]
—निन्द्य-ता, f. or
निन्द्य-त्व, अम्, n. blamableness, infamy, con-
temptibleness.

निन्व् निन्व् (or according to some सिन्व्),
cl. 1. P. निन्वति, &c., to wet or sprinkle;
or to attend, wait on, worship ?; (the two mean-
ings have probably arisen from a confusion between
सेचने and सेवने.)

नीनाह नीनाह, अस्, m., Ved. anything
which encircles another (?).
